title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode20 needLe

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki... Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Please forgive me!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When my classmates started ignoring me, I was terrified. But I couldn't bring myself to tell you what was going on.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was so afraid it would happen again in high school, so I did everything I could not to upset the few people in my class who were nice to me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I acted as if you weren't my friends any more, even though that hurt you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It all happened because I'm so spineless...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're not. I should apologize for not having been able to help you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wasn't there for you when you were having a really difficult time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I also shouldn't have left you alone for so long.
I noticed that something was wrong, but did nothing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: How can you still care about me after I shunned everyone and hurt your feelings...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It's simple.
You're our friend.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sorry about what I said earlier.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, you were right. You opened my eyes to what I was doing to all of you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If you hadn't gotten so angry with me, I'd have just carried on, telling myself everything was all right.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*...
Haha, your eyes are red from crying, guys.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You should take a look in the mirror.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I wasn't crying...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Join our band.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
We won't leave you alone ever again.
We'll always be together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Sure.
Thank you, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe! At last we're a band of four!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Honami, our band's no joke.
You've got to be serious about practice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yikes! Shiho's already putting the pressure on!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What? I'm just making it clear that if we're doing this together, we've got to do it right.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What is it, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm just so happy that I'll be in a band with you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think this is what I wanted right from the start.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You've finally discovered your true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh? My phone flashed?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Why are we back in the classroom?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Your feelings are about to turn into a song.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Honami, you're a part of it too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see. I, um...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm very grateful to you, Luka and Miku.
For showing us that wonderful starry sky.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You know what comes next, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We're gonna to play together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. Which song?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! My phone's doing it again!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, no... It's just Untitled that's flashing?
song00003_off_f

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's doing it on my phone too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Your feelings are becoming a song.
Would you mind if I sang with you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'd love you to, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's also your song. We wouldn't have discovered it if it weren't for you and Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, thanks. I suppose I'll join in too then.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika, let's sing together!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We played as if we'd known this song for a long time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That was awesome... So freaking awesome!
Like, super awesome!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I guess if this song expresses our feelings, then
they're feelings we've all shared since a long time ago.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah, I felt that too. It was so familiar and feel-good.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Look... The song's name is changing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now it's called needLe?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your feelings have crystallized into a song at last.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So there's a part of each of us...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: ...in this song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So this song is needLe, huh.
We'll treasure it.
